actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, FDR-controlled multi-modal identity: RNA shows 18/50 significant Hallmark pathways with moderate-to-large effect sizes concentrated in inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 and allograft-rejection programs, WXS shows BAP1 enrichment (OR=16.4, q=0.0157) with PBRM1 near threshold, and CNV shows a consistent chromosome 9 loss pattern (CDKN2A/JAK2, q=0.003). Membership is structurally compatible: the fused probe is internally organized (fraction positive 0.92, resample ARI 0.715) and no measured technical factor reaches significance (all q>=0.436), so no dominant alternative explanation is established. Boundaries to C0002/C0003 are weak, but weak separation alone does not positively support Split or Merge, and no available evidence request exists to resolve a decision-critical gap. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent identity defined by the strongest RNA signal among the sets (23/50 significant Hallmark pathways, min q=0.00265) with a directionally distinct program (up pancreas-beta-cells, down allograft rejection/IL6-JAK-STAT3) plus a distinct CNV profile (19/49 continuous features significant, absent CDKN2A loss, reduced 12p/16p/14q). WXS is weak, but a strong single-modality identity does not require corroboration from every modality. Membership is structurally organized (fraction positive 0.957), and although nominal site/manufacturer/kernel imbalances exist, none survives correction (all q=0.624), so no measured technical factor dominates the molecular signal. No positively supported Split or Merge and no resolvable evidence request exist. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a coherent identity concentrated in WXS: complete absence of PBRM1 mutation (q=4.59e-07) with reduced VHL mutation and sub-threshold trends toward higher 3p/VHL/SETD2/PBRM1 copy number. This is a strong, biologically interpretable single-modality signal, and the structural evidence is consistent with it (WXS probe silhouette 0.142, fused probe fraction positive 0.967, ARI 0.681). RNA and CNV do not reach FDR significance, but absence of significance in other modalities is not active contradiction and does not invalidate a strong single-modality-defined candidate. No measured technical factor is significant (all q>=0.687), and no positively supported Split or Merge or resolvable evidence request exists. Accept is better supported than Drop.
